## Type
- [ ] docs (roadmap text, guides, README)
- [ ] feat (new code / project / template)
- [ ] fix (bug, broken link, typo with code impact)
- [ ] chore (CI, tooling, formatting)

## Checklist
- [ ] Follows Conventional Commits (`docs:`, `feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`)
- [ ] Ran `make lint` and `make test` locally (or `make validate` for docs-only)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or large binaries added
- [ ] Links verified (`make links` or manual check for YouTube URLs)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated if user-facing change
